text:
elaine: Quick sync \u2014 need a final call on chat completions shape today. We have three asks from customers: canonical messages, a compatibility shim for prompt, and an immutable system role option. Thoughts?
ryan: I vote canonical = messages array (roles: system/user/assistant). Keep `prompt` as a server-side shim for migration.
chris: Engineering constraints: streaming + token accounting. If we transform `prompt` -> `messages` we must compute tokens after translation and stream without buffering full output.
maria: Compliance wants explicit enforcement for system messages at org-level (immutable system role). Also they want deterministic structured outputs with server-side schema validation.
vince: UX: allow optional `name` on assistant messages for multi-bot UX. Also return a deprecation header when `prompt` used.
sam: Rollout idea: feature-flag per-org. Start internal -> 5 pilot customers -> 10% canary w/ shadowing 48h -> 50% -> 100%. Circuit-breaker auto-rollback on thresholds.
chris: Circuit-breaker thresholds proposal: error_rate > 1% over 5m OR schema_hard_fail > 0.2% over 1h OR token_delta_p95 > 15% => failover to legacy handler.
ryan: Metrics to monitor: p50/p95 latency, regen rate, schema_ok_rate, schema_soft_fail_rate, schema_hard_fail_rate, token_delta p50/p95, compat.prompt usage, cost_delta.
maria: Structured outputs: add `schema` param opt-in; responses include `structured_output_status` = ok|soft_fail|hard_fail and `schema_errors` list on failures. `soft_fail` returns both text and structured attempt.
chris: Implementation owners: server shim + translation = eng-runtime (chris); circuit-breaker + rollback = eng-infra; schema validation = eng-ml (maria).
dev-rel-bot: Migration guide draft will be posted to #docs in ~2h with examples and SDK snippets.
elaine: Launch checklist (short): ensure SDKs expose messages + prompt shim, implement deprecation header + compat metric, validate token accounting pre-send, ensure streaming parity for shimmed requests, flag per-org, circuit-breaker + auto-rollback, schema validation fields, docs and migration guide, dashboard + alerts.
ryan: SDK recommendation: default constructors prefer `messages`, provide `fromPrompt()` helpers and show deprecation warnings.
vince: Example payload for docs (short):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model":"redwood-alpha-1",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are concise."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize notes."}],
  "schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}
}
```
elaine: Final decision summary: canonical = messages with roles; accept `prompt` shim with deprecation header; optional `name` on assistant; schema validation + function calling behind flags; org-level immutable system role; rollout via flagged canary + auto-rollback. I will file epics and tickets. If no objections by EOD Ill freeze shape. :rocket:
